form_type.name: urn:xmpp:ssn
form_type.desc: Forms enabling negotation of a one-to-one session between two entities.

field.label: Another resource with which to continue the session
Disclosure of content, decryption keys or identities

option.label: Entities guarantee no disclosure features exist (not even disabled features)
Entities MUST NOT disclose (except for those disclosures that are required by law)

field.label: Whether may send Chat State Notifications per XEP-0085
Whether allowed to use XHTML-IM formatting per XEP-0071
Primary written language of the chat (each value appears in order of preference and conforms to RFC 4646 and the IANA registry)
Whether allowed to log messages (i.e., whether Off-The-Record mode is required)

option.label: Disallow All Message Logging (i.e., must disable absolutely all message logging including automatic archiving -- see XEP-0136

field.label: Whether to allow multiple concurrent sessions between the parties

option.label: Both parties must be securely connected to their servers
Both parties must be securely connected to each other
